_instructions: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values. Then run: python3 setup.py
_comment_email: Set email_enabled to false to stop receiving the daily summary email
_comment_telemetry: Anonymous usage stats (team count, RSVP counts, features used). No names or personal data. Set to false to opt out.

teams._comment: A TeamSnap team. Find teamsnap_team_id in the URL when viewing your team at app.teamsnap.com
Set driving:false when another parent always drives (e.g. head coach)
A PlayMetrics/SportsEngine/SportNgin team. Run setup.py to find your team_id and persona_id.
Optional: override event duration. game_duration_minutes and practice_duration_minutes are both optional.
